SELECT s.source_id,sv.source_version,pv.parse_version,ri.index_version,c.chunk_id,g.approval_revision, sv.rights_revision,r.purpose AS rights_purpose,s.title,LEFT(c.raw_text,1200) AS excerpt, CHAR_LENGTH(c.raw_text)>1200 AS excerpt_truncated,c.locator, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.locator,'$.kind')) AS locator_kind,c.quote_hash, CAST(GREATEST(MATCH(c.search_text) AGAINST(#{queryText} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE), CASE WHEN s.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryText},'%') THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(20,10)) AS relevance FROM source_chunk c JOIN parse_version pv ON pv.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND pv.source_version=c.source_version AND pv.parse_version=c.parse_version JOIN source_version sv ON sv.tenant_id=pv.tenant_id AND sv.source_version=pv.source_version JOIN source s ON s.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND s.source_id=sv.source_id JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=pv.tenant_id AND g.source_version=pv.source_version AND g.parse_version=pv.parse_version JOIN approval_decision a ON a.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND a.source_version=g.source_version AND a.parse_version=g.parse_version AND a.approval_revision=g.approval_revision JOIN rights_revision r ON r.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND r.rights_revision=sv.rights_revision JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id,source_version,parse_version,MIN(index_version) AS index_version FROM index_manifest WHERE status='READY' AND mode IN ('FULLTEXT','HYBRID') AND expected_count>0 AND verified_count=expected_count
AND (source_version=#{fixed.sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{fixed.parseVersion} AND index_version=#{fixed.indexVersion}) 1=0
GROUP BY tenant_id,source_version,parse_version ) ri ON ri.tenant_id=pv.tenant_id AND ri.source_version=pv.source_version AND ri.parse_version=pv.parse_version WHERE pv.parse_status='COMPLETE' AND g.upload_status='RECEIVED' AND g.approval_status='APPROVED' AND g.lifecycle='ACTIVE' AND a.decision='APPROVE' AND r.status='APPROVED' AND (r.valid_from IS NULL OR r.valid_from<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND JSON_CONTAINS(r.allowed_actions,JSON_QUOTE('READ')) AND JSON_CONTAINS(r.regions,JSON_QUOTE(#{region})) AND JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(r.evidence_manifest,'$.environments'),JSON_QUOTE(#{environment})) AND JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(r.evidence_manifest,'$.classifications'),JSON_QUOTE(s.classification)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_source_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=sv.tenant_id AND b.project_id=#{projectId} AND b.source_version=sv.source_version AND b.is_current=TRUE AND b.applicability='APPLICABLE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM permission_grant pg WHERE pg.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND pg.subject_id=#{userId} AND pg.action='source.read' AND pg.status='ACTIVE' AND pg.valid_from<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (pg.valid_to IS NULL OR pg.valid_to>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(pg.`condition`,'$.identity_modes'),JSON_QUOTE(#{identityMode})) AND (JSON_EXTRACT(pg.`condition`,'$.purposes') IS NULL OR JSON_CONTAINS(JSON_EXTRACT(pg.`condition`,'$.purposes'),JSON_QUOTE(r.purpose))) AND (pg.resource_kind='ENTERPRISE' AND pg.project_id IS NULL AND pg.resource_id=s.tenant_id OR pg.resource_kind='PROJECT' AND s.owner_project_id IS NOT NULL AND pg.project_id=s.owner_project_id AND pg.resource_id=s.owner_project_id OR pg.resource_kind='SOURCE' AND pg.project_id<=>s.owner_project_id AND (pg.resource_id IS NULL OR pg.resource_id=s.source_id))) AND (MATCH(c.search_text) AGAINST(#{queryText} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)>0 OR s.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{queryText},'%'))
AND (sv.source_version=#{fixed.sourceVersion} AND pv.parse_version=#{fixed.parseVersion} AND ri.index_version=#{fixed.indexVersion} AND g.approval_revision=#{fixed.approvalRevision} AND sv.rights_revision=#{fixed.rightsRevision}) 1=0
ORDER BY relevance DESC,sv.source_version,pv.parse_version,c.chunk_id LIMIT 501

SELECT tenant_id,project_id,retrieval_id,subject_id,query_text,query_sha256,purpose,mode,selection_sha256, auth_epoch,governance_epoch,result_count,status,created_by,created_at,classification FROM retrieval_query q WHERE q.retrieval_id=#{retrievalId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT h.rank_no,h.source_id,h.source_version,h.parse_version,h.index_version,h.chunk_id,h.approval_revision, h.rights_revision,r.purpose AS rights_purpose,h.title,h.excerpt,h.excerpt_truncated, h.locator,h.locator_kind,h.quote_hash,h.relevance FROM retrieval_hit h JOIN rights_revision r ON r.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND r.rights_revision=h.rights_revision AND r.status='APPROVED' JOIN parse_version pv ON pv.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND pv.source_version=h.source_version AND pv.parse_version=h.parse_version AND pv.parse_status='COMPLETE' JOIN source_chunk c ON c.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND c.source_version=h.source_version AND c.parse_version=h.parse_version AND c.chunk_id=h.chunk_id AND c.quote_hash=h.quote_hash AND c.locator=h.locator JOIN index_manifest i ON i.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND i.source_version=h.source_version AND i.parse_version=h.parse_version AND i.index_version=h.index_version AND i.status='READY' AND i.expected_count>0 AND i.verified_count=i.expected_count JOIN source_use_gate g ON g.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND g.source_version=h.source_version AND g.parse_version=h.parse_version AND g.approval_revision=h.approval_revision AND g.upload_status='RECEIVED' AND g.approval_status='APPROVED' AND g.lifecycle='ACTIVE' JOIN approval_decision a ON a.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND a.source_version=h.source_version AND a.parse_version=h.parse_version AND a.approval_revision=h.approval_revision AND a.decision='APPROVE' WHERE h.retrieval_id=#{retrievalId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_source_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND b.project_id=h.project_id AND b.source_version=h.source_version AND b.is_current=TRUE AND b.applicability='APPLICABLE') ORDER BY h.rank_no LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record o WHERE o.subject_id=#{userId} AND o.operation_name='KN-14-S04' AND o.idempotency_key=#{key}
